name: setup-care-services-before
assert: (()=>{const t=document.body.innerText;return t.includes('Care services')&&t.includes('1 care service not yet active')&&t.includes('Wound dressing')&&t.includes('Draft')&&!t.includes('Haemoglobin')&&!t.includes('Full blood count')&&!t.includes('Hepatitis C antibody')&&!t.includes('Server accepted')&&t.includes('Lab tests, medicines and other catalogue items')})()
description: Step 4 lists only care services: lab tests are not shown or counted, and no server-acceptance status appears
Five active lab tests do not complete the step; the draft care service only marks it Started
Lab catalogue and pharmacy stock are reached from When you need them

name: setup-care-services-add-preset
description: A predefined service asks only for team and place, with a non-laboratory team and its own room chosen by default

assert: (()=>{const d=document.querySelector('dialog[open]');const add=[...d.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.textContent.trim()==='Add care service');return d.innerText.includes('Confirm it is you')&&add.disabled})()
description: Without a confirmed staff session the sheet asks for the PIN and nothing can be saved

name: setup-care-services-pin-confirmed
description: After the PIN is confirmed by the server the service can be added

name: setup-care-services-after
assert: (()=>{const t=document.body.innerText;const s=document.querySelector('nav[aria-label="Setup steps"] [aria-current=step]');return !document.querySelector('dialog[open]')&&t.includes('1 active care service')&&t.includes('General outpatient consultation')&&t.includes('Consultation · Consulting room 1')&&t.includes('Active')&&s.textContent.includes('Done')&&![...document.querySelectorAll('section[aria-labelledby=care-services-add] li button')].some(b=>b.textContent.startsWith('General outpatient consultation'))})()
description: The added care service is Active, completes the step, and is no longer offered as an option to add

name: setup-care-services-duplicate-refused
assert: document.querySelector('dialog[open] [role=alert]')?.textContent.includes('is already one of this hospital')===true
description: A second offering with the same meaning is refused

name: setup-care-services-inpatient
description: Inpatient care defaults to a ward, and individual beds are not offered as service places
Lab test definitions and offerings are untouched; adding one care service created exactly one definition and one offering

name: setup-prices-notes
assert: (()=>{const t=document.body.innerText;return t.includes('5 lab tests without a price. Set them in the Lab catalogue.')&&!t.includes('service without a price')&&!t.includes('services without a price')})()
description: Prices advice names unpriced lab tests only; care services are charged through visit fees

name: setup-teams-status
description: Teams list shows a business status instead of server acceptance

name: setup-lab-catalogue-intact
assert: (()=>{const t=document.body.innerText;return ['Haemoglobin','Full blood count','Blood group and Rh','Hepatitis C antibody','Urine culture and sensitivity'].every(n=>t.includes(n))&&!t.includes('General outpatient consultation')})()
description: The Lab catalogue still lists every test, and care services do not appear in it

name: setup-care-services-phone
description: At phone width the step fits without horizontal scrolling
